datasets.name: Landslide inventory of the Three Gorges Reservoir Area (TGRA)
datasets.source: Authors' own compilation via onsite inspections and visual interpretation
datasets.verbatim: According to onsite inspections and analysis of remote sensing images, a total of 486 historical landslides were recorded through visual interpretation (see Figure 1(a) for landslide site locations).

datasets.name: Sentinel-2A multispectral images
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2 multispectral images, with a scanning bandwidth of 290 km and a data policy that allows free and open access, have been extensively used for detecting landslides. The available cloud-free imagery that was obtained on 7 December 2019, was downloaded.

datasets.name: ASTER GDEM V3 data
datasets.verbatim: These topographical features were derived from ASTER GDEM V3 data.

methods.name: ENVINet5-based classification model with multisource data fusion
methods.summary: A deep learning classifier based on the ENVINet5 architecture that integrates spectral, textural (GLCM-based), and topographical features to detect old landslides. It uses Grad-CAM for visual explanation of the model's decision-making process.
methods.verbatim: ENVINet5 was implemented in ENVI (version 5.6) using the DL module (version 1.1.3).

availability.author_statement: The data supporting this study’s findings are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or provided, and the custom classification model code is not available.
